goalZh: 读懂网上的短点评,分清好评和差评,找出顾客喜欢和不满意的地方
canDoZh: 能读懂网上的短点评,分清好评和差评,找出顾客喜欢和不喜欢什么

newItems.noteZh: 重音在后 re-VIEW;网上的 customer reviews 是顾客点评。
点评的星级:five stars 五颗星;st 之间不要加元音,结尾卷舌。
美式拼写 favorite(英式 favourite);它本身就是“最喜欢的”,不说 most favorite。My favorite drink is… 我最喜欢的饮料是……

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.zh: (磊第一次独立当班后,马库斯给他看顾客在网上写的点评)我们咖啡馆:顾客点评

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Five stars! The latte is delicious.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: And Lei is really friendly. Thanks, Lei!
lines.zh: 磊特别友好。谢谢你,磊!(磊的胸牌上写着名字)

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: Four stars. Great coffee, but at noon it's really busy.
lines.zh: (第二条,老顾客写的)四颗星。咖啡很棒,但中午人特别多。

lines.speaker: regular
lines.text: Now I'm here every afternoon: large hot coffee, no sugar!
lines.zh: 所以我现在每天下午来:大杯热咖啡,不加糖!

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Three stars. The coffee is OK, but my tea isn't hot.
lines.zh: (第三条)三颗星。咖啡还行,但我的茶不够热。

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: The cafe is small, and it's always busy.
lines.zh: 店里很小,而且总是很挤。

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Five stars! My favorite drink is the oat milk latte.
lines.zh: (第四条)五颗星!我最喜欢的饮料是燕麦奶拿铁。

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: With vanilla and no sugar. Delicious!
lines.zh: 加香草,不加糖。太好喝了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.zh: (磊看完,有点不好意思)“特别友好”?说的是我?太好了!

questions.explainZh: 第一条写 The latte is delicious. 和 Lei is really friendly.(拿铁很好喝,磊特别友好。)

questions.prompt: 老顾客为什么只给了四颗星?
questions.explainZh: 他写 Great coffee, but at noon it's really busy.——but 前面是优点,后面是缺点:中午人特别多。

questions.prompt: 给三颗星的顾客不满意什么?
options: 茶不够热,店里又小又挤
questions.explainZh: 第三条写 my tea isn't hot(我的茶不够热)和 The cafe is small, and it's always busy.(店里很小,总是很挤。)

questions.prompt: 第四条点评的顾客最喜欢什么饮料?
options: 燕麦奶拿铁,加香草、不加糖
questions.explainZh: 第四条写 My favorite drink is the oat milk latte. With vanilla and no sugar.;大杯热咖啡是老顾客每天点的。

grammar.titleZh: 读点评:先看星级,再看 but 后面
grammar.bodyZh: 网上的点评先看星级:five stars 最好,one star 最差。再看文字里的 but:but 前面多是优点,后面是缺点。Great coffee, but at noon it's really busy.(咖啡很棒,但中午人特别多)——but 后面的缺点,就是没给五颗星的原因。复习 be + 形容词:The latte is delicious.、Lei is really friendly.、It's always busy.。读的时候留意星级和文字对不对得上:五颗星的点评一般全是好话,三四颗星的常常有一个 but。

examples.text: Five stars! The latte is delicious.
Great coffee, but at noon it's really busy.
examples.zh: 咖啡很棒,但中午人特别多。

examples.text: My favorite drink is the oat milk latte.
examples.zh: 我最喜欢的饮料是燕麦奶拿铁。
